_readme: sim303 (SPICE-equivalent, see results.md). key = <model set>_<note>. sq = Q8 collector (V, mean removed; Q8 on = positive), band-limited like octa303_q8.table() at fs 44100; sq_raw = same without band-limit; saw = Q28 source (V, mean removed). Index 0 = saw reset (middle of its upward jump). The saw FALLS through the cycle.
